reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-10-27 captured Sky book (feed datetime 2026-10-27T16:15:32Z) reports total group debt $10,634,677,862.306377 across eight groups. At Ethereum block 26285175 (hash 0xa86483d8286713b73125b62e640f380b17af4c93a34cfd452f6bed94f27e9e4d, timestamp 2026-10-27T16:14:35Z), LitePSM 0xf6e72db5454dd049d0788e411b06cfaf16853042 gem() returns canonical USDC and pocket() returns 0x37305b1cd40574e4c5ce33f8e8306be057fd7341, which holds $3,855,731,228.735728 USDC. Stablecoins group debt is $3,855,731,229.686523, so measured USDC is within $0.95 of it (no excess); the measured stock is 36.2562% of total debt and is attributed in full, rounded with the group shares to 36.26%. The residual keyed row is a classification row of about $0.95 (under 0.0001 percentage points) and is shown as 0, not a holding. Both DAI and USDS share this book. Allocators remain classified at their deployed-strategy failure domain. Group shares changed from the 2026-09-29 capture mainly through lower stablecoins (39.4 to 36.26), higher Grove (16.7 to 17.69), higher Spark (33.6 to 36.35) and a near-empty Osero group (0.5 to 0.05).
reserveReview.compositionBasis: 2026-10-27 captured group-debt shares (two-decimal rounding sums to 100.00); canonical gem() and measured LitePSM USDC pocket balance at block 26285175 with explicit reconciliation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Unexplained positive PSM remainders stay unlinked; excess above 0.25 percentage points fails the split closed. Allocator groups have no invented tracked-token look-through weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Grove is a Sky Agent allocation into institutional-credit strategies, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Spark is an allocator and lending-protocol position with multiple deployment counterparties, not a direct wrapper around one tracked stablecoin.
Obex is an Agent allocation across supported institutional stablecoin projects rather than one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Core bucket is a multi-collateral crypto-vault pool, not one canonical tracked reserve asset.
The Staking Engine bucket is collateralized by SKY positions in LockStake Engine vaults, not by another tracked stablecoin.
The legacy RWA bucket represents external legal structures and obligors rather than a direct tracked-stablecoin dependency.
Osero is a Sky allocator position with mutable deployed strategies rather than one direct tracked-stablecoin reserve asset.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: This partial profile identifies on-chain collateral holding infrastructure, not a complete list of legal custodians. At Ethereum block 26095796, LitePSM.gem() identifies canonical USDC and LitePSM.pocket() identifies the named pocket. Grove describes its Allocator as non-custodial vault infrastructure. The cited sources do not establish asset-wide segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation restrictions, or legal custodian allocation shares for the shared DAI/USDS book. Underlying RWA and allocator strategy custody remains unresolved; the institutional-top summary is not independently substantiated by this profile.
